id: \bA lot of Ghost Pokémon live in this section of the Wild Area.
en: \bA lot of Ghost Pokémon live in this section of the Wild Area.
it: \bIn questa zona delle Terre Selvagge vivono molti Pokémon di tipo Spettro.

id: \bI come to study this rock formation from time to time. It's said you can evolve Yamask here after it's hurt.
en: \bI come to study this rock formation from time to time.  It's said you can evolve Yamask here after it's hurt.
it: \bOgni tanto vengo a studiare questa formazione rocciosa. Si dice che qui Yamask possa evolversi dopo aver subito danni.

id: \bI've never gone past this desert. I always get too tired.
en: \bI've never gone past this desert. I always get too tired.
it: \bNon sono mai andato oltre questo deserto. Mi stanco sempre troppo.

id: \rDon't get in my way. I'm going to get a Braviary so I never have to walk again!
en: \rDon't get in my way. I'm going to get a Braviary so I never have to walk again!
it: \rNon metterti in mezzo. Prenderò un Braviary così non dovrò mai più camminare!
